title: Lekalo MCP tool input: target-status
description: Issue #33 closed request grammar of the target-status tool. Structural violations (missing, unknown, wrong-typed, or out-of-range members) are JSON-RPC -32602; cross-field semantic invariants are the typed mcp.input-invalid refusal. projectId must name a server-catalog project; groupId an optional catalog group of that project.
